scheme_name: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Insurance Scheme
other_conditions: Holders of Rice Card (BPL) are eligible
Families eligible for YSR Pension Kanuka Card, Jagananna Vidya Card or Vasathi Deevena Card are eligible
Landowners with less than 12 acres of wet land, less than 35 acres of dry land, and total land less than 35 acres
Households with annual income up to Rs.5 lakh (salary certificate evidence required)
Income‑tax‑paying families filing returns with annual income up to Rs.5 lakh (income‑tax‑return evidence required)
Employees (excluding permanent government employees/pensioners) with annual income up to Rs.5 lakh, including contract, part‑time, outsourcing, sanitary, honorarium and private‑sector workers
Households paying municipal property tax for property area less than 3000 sq ft
Families/households not owning more than one personal car
benefits_summary: Cashless coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family for inpatient and outpatient treatment, including pre‑existing diseases, across a wide range of specialties.
